title: TenantSecurityPolicyChangeLog - Data API
description: Tracks changes to Security Center policy fields. Each record represents a single field change on a policy.

Field.description: The name of the field that was changed.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The unique identifier for the change log record.

NewValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NewValue.description: The new value of the field that was changed.

OldValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
OldValue.description: The latest value of the field before it was changed.

PolicyIdentifier.description: The ID of this policy. Contains a unique virtual key from child to parent.

associated_objects: This object doesn't have associated objects.
